categories.main_business_segments: Gordon Auto Body Parts Co., Ltd. primarily manufactures and sells auto body parts for the automotive aftermarket, including fenders, hoods, car doors, and lights. The company also engages in mold processing and related automotive parts manufacturing. Its products mainly serve the automotive after-sales maintenance market (AM), focusing on metal collision parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including stamping processes (cutting, drawing, trimming, hemming, shaping), mold development, and plastic injection for automotive lamps. It utilizes high-tech automation equipment such as CNC engraving machines, 3D measuring machines, laser cutting, welding machines, and optical scanning systems. R&D efforts focus on lightweight materials like aluminum and high-strength steel, CAE simulation, and reverse engineering to shorten mold development time and improve quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Gordon serves mainly the automotive aftermarket (AM) sector, supplying certified sheet metal collision parts to major insurance companies and repair shops. Its key customers are in North America, Europe, China, and emerging markets such as South America and the Middle East. The company is a major supplier of CAPA-certified parts in North America and holds certifications recognized in Europe and China, targeting insurance companies and automotive repair markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with significant export markets including the United States (largest market), Europe, China, and emerging markets in South America and the Middle East. In 2024, exports accounted for approximately 66% of sales, with 40.61% to the USA, 14.48% to Europe, and 11.15% to other countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gordon operates in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying auto body parts and components to downstream customers such as automotive repair shops and insurance companies. It sources raw materials like steel sheets directly from upstream suppliers such as China Steel Corporation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes developing high-margin product lines, expanding mold development capacity, and improving mold quality and development speed. It invests in R&D for lightweight and high-strength materials, reverse engineering, and certification to enhance product competitiveness. Strategic focus includes expanding market share in North America, Europe, and emerging markets, and increasing certified product offerings to meet evolving customer demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured auto body parts and components, including sheet metal collision parts and molds. The company also earns processing income from mold-related services. Sales are largely export-driven, with a focus on certified aftermarket parts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from many domestic manufacturers in Taiwan's automotive sheet metal export industry, which creates pricing pressure. Gordon differentiates itself through extensive mold development, high product quality with multiple certifications (CAPA, TUV, Thatcham, NSF), and a broad product portfolio. It is positioned as a leading supplier in the global automotive aftermarket, especially in North America and China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Gordon reported net operating income of approximately NT$3.02 billion, a year-over-year increase of 11.79%, with net profit after tax of NT$597 million, up 69.89%. Total assets were about NT$5.23 billion with equity of NT$3.1 billion. The company has shown steady revenue and profit growth, supported by increased sales volume and improved gross profit margins.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gordon emphasizes quality, technology, innovation, and customer service as its core values. It offers certified, high-quality aftermarket collision parts at competitive prices, leveraging advanced R&D and manufacturing capabilities. The company’s extensive mold development and certification portfolio enable it to meet diverse customer needs globally, particularly in the North American and European aftermarket sectors.
